name: offering-categories-01
title: Offering Categories 01 - Kinds Of Capability As A Grid Or A Tab Row
description: A set of kinds of capability, each with a name, a one-line description, a caller-composed count and a link, drawn as a grid of tiles or as a tab row with the caller's own panel underneath. The grid is the default because tabs hide five of six answers behind a control, and a count with no label function throws rather than printing a bare numeral.
